nodes.name: .clippy.toml
nodes.summary: Clippy lint configuration that disallows the use of time::format_description::well_known::Rfc2822 type pending an upgrade to time >=0.3.47 to address GHSA-r6v5-fh4h-64xc.

nodes.name: CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md
nodes.summary: Code of conduct for the Servo project, adopting the Rust Code of Conduct with Servo-specific designated contacts and scope covering Zulip channels, GitHub repositories, and official venues.

nodes.name: CONTRIBUTING.md
nodes.summary: Brief redirect to the Servo Book's contributing guide, pointing contributors to the official documentation at book.servo.org.

nodes.name: Cargo.toml
nodes.summary: Root workspace Cargo.toml defining the Servo workspace with 11 member crates, over 250 workspace dependencies, build profiles for development/release/CI/coverage/profiling, a local path dependency section, and a Stylo patch section.
nodes.languageNotes: Extensive workspace-level dependency management with pinned revisions for Stylo crates, multiple optimization profiles (checked-release, coverage, medium, production, production-stripped), and workspace-local path dependencies listed in a dedicated greppable section.

nodes.name: PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md
nodes.summary: GitHub pull request template prompting contributors to describe changes, testing approach, and related issues for each pull request.

nodes.name: README.md
nodes.summary: Project overview and getting-started guide covering the Servo parallel browser engine, with platform-specific build instructions for macOS, Linux, Windows, Android, and OpenHarmony.

nodes.name: SECURITY.md
nodes.summary: Security policy directing reporters to submit security-related issues as GitHub security advisories.

nodes.name: about.toml
nodes.summary: License acceptance list for cargo-about tool, enumerating 18 SPDX-identified open source licenses approved for use in the Servo project dependencies.

nodes.name: deny.toml
nodes.summary: Cargo-deny configuration governing advisory ignores, license allowances, and dependency bans for the workspace, with skip lists for duplicated crate versions and a source allowlist scoped to the servo GitHub organization.
nodes.languageNotes: Comprehensive cargo-deny configuration with per-crate license exceptions and an extensive skip list for version dupes across transitive dependencies.

nodes.name: mach.bat
nodes.summary: Windows batch wrapper for the Servo build system, setting UV_PYTHON to arm64 on ARM64 processors and delegating to the Python-based mach script via uv.

nodes.name: mach.ps1
nodes.summary: PowerShell wrapper for the Servo build system with glob argument expansion, ARM64 architecture detection for UV_PYTHON override, and delegation to the Python-based mach script via uv.

nodes.name: pyproject.toml
nodes.summary: Python project configuration specifying Ruff linting rules (120 char width, type annotation checks), Pyrefly type-checking search paths, setuptools dynamic dependencies, and UV native-tls setting.
nodes.languageNotes: Combines Python project metadata, lint rules, type checker configuration, and package management settings in a single pyproject.toml.

nodes.name: rust-toolchain.toml
nodes.summary: Rust toolchain specification pinning the project to nightly channel 1.95.0 with components including clippy, llvm-tools, rustc-dev, rustfmt, and rust-src.

nodes.name: rustfmt.toml
nodes.summary: Rustfmt configuration enabling trailing commas in match blocks, import reordering, and the 2024 style edition.

nodes.name: servo-tidy.toml
nodes.summary: Servo-specific tidy and lint configuration defining disallowed co-authors (AI assistants), ignored files and directories for lint checks, and expected file extensions for WebIDL bindings.

nodes.name: svg-geometry-todo.md
nodes.summary: Todo list tracking outstanding tasks and progress for SVG geometry implementation work within the Servo browser engine.

nodes.name: taplo.toml
nodes.summary: Taplo TOML formatter configuration excluding third-party and test files, with 120-column width, 4-space indentation, and disabled auto-collapse/expand for arrays.
